cohort: 107 women readmitted to hospital following caesarean section out of 2470 women who gave birth by caesarean section in an Irish maternity hospital between August 1, 2014 and July 31, 2015.
finding: Abdominal wound infection was the most common reason for readmission to hospital following caesarean section.
mod_finding: Women who underwent emergency caesarean section were more likely to be readmitted for wound infection compared to those who underwent elective caesarean section (2.47% vs 1.86%).
